chapter_sources.title: One protein, two states
chapter_sources.speech: ACE2 is not simply a docking site for a virus. Its position matters. The membrane-bound receptor and its shed soluble ectodomain can have different biological consequences.

chapter_sources.title: The binding interface is real
chapter_sources.speech: This molecular trace comes from crystal structure six M zero J: human ACE2 bound to the SARS CoV two spike receptor-binding domain. These are experimentally determined coordinates.
chapter_sources.source: PDB 6M0J; Lan et al., Nature 2020; X-ray diffraction at 2.45 Å; this depicts the extracellular binding interface only.

chapter_sources.title: An enzyme within a network
chapter_sources.speech: ACE2 also processes angiotensin two to angiotensin one to seven, helping counterbalance signalling elsewhere in the renin angiotensin system. It is not a one-way viral-entry switch.
chapter_sources.source: The review's original Figure 3: RAAS schematic, CC BY 4.0. Diagram is illustrative, not a measured trial result.

chapter_sources.title: The membrane is a boundary
chapter_sources.speech: Membrane ACE2 has an extracellular catalytic domain connected through the cell membrane to an intracellular tail. A picture of the isolated protein cannot represent that whole context.
chapter_sources.source: 2021 review ACE2 domain and shedding discussion; original conceptual membrane scene; not drawn from 6M0J.

chapter_sources.title: Shedding changes the question
chapter_sources.speech: Proteolytic shedding can release ACE2's catalytic ectodomain into extracellular fluid. Soluble ACE2 retains enzymatic activity, but its consequences depend on tissue, timing, and disease state.
chapter_sources.source: 2021 review section 2.3: soluble/membrane ACE2 and enzymatically active released ectodomain.

chapter_sources.title: Binding is not infection
chapter_sources.speech: The receptor-binding event is an initial step, not a complete account of infection. Entry also depends on host proteases and cellular processes. No single diagram explains every tissue.
chapter_sources.source: 2021 review section 2.1, membrane fusion/endocytic processes; original author conceptual, no third-party Figure 1 reused.

chapter_sources.title: Association is not intervention
chapter_sources.speech: ACE2 expression varies across tissues, illnesses, and medication exposure. Observational associations cannot by themselves show that changing ACE2 improves a patient's outcome.
chapter_sources.source: 2021 review disease and ACE inhibitor / ARB evidence, limitations; no invented tissue counts or treatment recommendation.

chapter_sources.title: Two forms, open questions
chapter_sources.speech: The same protein participates in protective enzymatic signalling and viral receptor binding. The review asks how membrane and soluble forms alter risk. It does not settle that question.
chapter_sources.source: Paper Abstract and conclusions, 2021; an evidence-bound review, not a prospective clinical trial.
